WITH cleaned_sales AS (
    SELECT
        "Ngày",
        "STT",
        "Khách",
        "Hàng",
        "SL",
        "Giá",
        "Thành tiền",
        "Bớt",
        "Thu máy cũ",
        "Ghi chú",
        "_don_huy",
        "_don_tra",
        "_sheet"
    FROM "sobanhang_so_ban_hang"
),
cleaned_catalog AS (
    SELECT
        "Ghi tắt",
        "Tên hàng",
        "Loại",
        "_sheet"
    FROM "sobanhang_ghi_tat"
)
SELECT
    -- order_id
    CAST(c."Ngày" AS DATE) || '-' || c."STT" AS order_id,
    -- order_date
    CAST(c."Ngày" AS DATE) AS order_date,
    -- order_ts
    CAST(c."Ngày" AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts,
    -- product_code
    COALESCE(cat."Ghi tắt", c."Hàng") AS product_code,
    -- product_group
    COALESCE(cat."Loại", NULL) AS product_group,
    -- product_name
    COALESCE(cat."Tên hàng", c."Hàng") AS product_name,
    -- qty
    c."SL" AS qty,
    -- unit
    NULL::VARCHAR AS unit,
    -- amount
    c."Thành tiền" AS amount,
    -- customer_id
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(c."Khách")) IN ('khách lẻ', 'lẻ', 'kl', 'walk-in', 'vãng lai', '') THEN NULL
        ELSE NULL -- No explicit ID code, just name
    END AS customer_id,
    -- customer_name
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(c."Khách")) IN ('khách lẻ', 'lẻ', 'kl', 'walk-in', 'vãng lai', '') THEN NULL
        ELSE c."Khách"
    END AS customer_name,
    -- staff, channel, payment
    NULL::VARCHAR AS staff,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS channel,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS payment,
    -- is_cancelled
    c._don_huy OR (c."Ghi chú" ILIKE '%hủy%') AS is_cancelled,
    -- is_returned
    c._don_tra OR (c."Ghi chú" ILIKE '%trả lại%' OR c."Ghi chú" ILIKE '%khách trả%') AS is_returned,
    -- line_kind
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(cat."Loại", c."Hàng") IN ('máy mới', 'máy cũ', 'phụ kiện') THEN 'item'
        ELSE 'item' -- Default to item as per mobile phone shop rules
    END AS line_kind
FROM cleaned_sales c
LEFT JOIN cleaned_catalog cat
    ON LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(c."Hàng", ' +', ' ', 'g'))) = 
       LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(cat."Ghi tắt", ' +', ' ', 'g')))
    OR LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(c."Hàng", ' +', ' ', 'g'))) = 
       LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(cat."Tên hàng", ' +', ' ', 'g')))
